calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-03-2009 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of one Adult and Three Minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William R. Gargano, Clerk: Kevin Dougherty, CSR: Lois Jones, #3689.

Mandip Dhillon, Esq. appeared with petitioners Abdulsalam Hamood Alghazali and Asma Fadel Ali Babakr, who were present in pro per as Guardians ad litem for the minors Abdulmalik Abdulsalam Alghazali, Hamza Abdulsalam Alghazali and Azal Abdulsalam Alghazali.
Petitioners were placed under oath and examined.
Proof of Publication in the file.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of an Adult to: Omar Hamood Alaudi.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to: Abdulmalik Omar Alaudi, Hamza Omar Alaudi and Azal Omar Alaudi.

Decree Changing Names was submitted to and signed by the Court.
